name: simplicio-prompt
description: Tuple-Space + Yool safe-speed runtime for Claude Code. A UserPromptSubmit hook makes it always-on (injects the runtime contract on every prompt unless the user stands down). Routes any user input through a Hilbert-indexed tuple graph with lazy batch_spawn, LaneWorkerPool, receipt cache, jittered backoff, circuit breakers and context compression. Scales to 1,000,000+ subagents without enumeration, and runs real subagents on any OpenAI-compatible provider.
author: Wesley Simplicio
